race.comment: SPIRITART (5) gets top billing after a much sharper Bunbury second behind Dynastic Lass, where she began awkwardly, travelled well and was beaten just under two lengths. The move to 1600m is the obvious qualification given she is unplaced in two attempts at the trip, but that latest run reads as the strongest piece of form. SQUAD GOAL (8) is the immediate danger after charging home to miss by a long neck at this track and looks suited on the quick back up. ZALI'S GIFT (4) has not won in 15 starts and was below market expectation last time, yet her previous Bunbury run was sound and she has the ratings profile to rebound. MONEY MANZIEL (12) was beaten just under a length on debut at York, gets weight relief and has enough natural upside to be a serious winning chance second-up.
